purpose: Display a bounded offline thumbnail of an already-rendered, recipe-bound output without rerendering or authorizing export.

inputs.eligible_rows: Valid rows with PNG, 16-bit, film-inspired/look-approximation output facts.
inputs.output_file_identity: The complete output file SHA-256 must equal the recipe-bound output SHA-256 before pixel decode.

preview.resampling: OpenCV INTER_AREA after exact uint16 RGB PNG decode
preview.quantization: round clipped RGB16 samples to sRGB8
preview.encoding: deterministic in-memory PNG with pinned sRGB ICC bytes
preview.document: self-contained offline HTML with data:image/png;base64 previews

failure_policy.nonfinite_or_boundary_case: not applicable to exact uint16 source samples

information_flow.output_file_reads: Only the recipe-bound existing render after size and path checks.

relationship_to_u7_2c: All visible labels remain film-inspired/look-approximation; preview presence does not establish calibrated or perceptually distinguishable film stocks.
claim_ceiling: Private read-only offline previews of three already-rendered, hash-bound look-approximation outputs only; no rerender, export, calibrated stock, stock distinguishability, packaging, telemetry or product-release claim.
